description: Bidesarea_WMS_Carreteras is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.araba.eus. WMS service with the Road Network of the Provincial Council of Álava. Information based on the 2016-2027 Comprehensive Road Plan (PICA). Informative nature, non-binding. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Bidesarea_WMS_Roads" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Punto kilométrico, ARABA/ÁLAVA. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
